name: ad-sync-worker
description: AD Sync Worker Lambda — batch sync per tenant

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild ./*.mjs --entry-names=./[name] --bundle --minify --sourcemap --platform=node --target=node20.16 --format=esm --out-extension:.js=.mjs --outdir=dist --external:@aws-sdk/* --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
